knowledge:
- key_parameters: counts_file/counts_matrix=Path or data frame of the gene-by-cell read counts matrix ;; cell_info_file/cell_info_table=Path or data frame of cell-level metadata ;; group_col_name=The column name in cell metadata containing cluster/group assignments ;; cell_col_name=The column name in cell metadata containing unique cell identifiers ;; dataset_name=A string label for the dataset used in output tables ;; num_cores=Number of cores for parallel processing in contrast_each_group_to_the_rest (highly recommended to set to the number of query groups) ;; n.group/n.other=Subsampling sizes for handling large datasets in contrast_each_group_to_the_rest ;; min_lib_size/min_group_membership/min_detected_by_min_samples=Filtering thresholds used in trim_small_groups_and_low_expression_genes ;; new_id/eval_col=Target ID column and tie-breaker column (e.g., total read count) used in convert_se_gene_ids ;; extra_factor_name=Optional batch/individual covariate for microarray limma analysis ;; log10trans=Logical to log-transform the y-axis in make_ranking_violin_plot to focus on top-ranked genes ;; num_steps=Step distance for testing non-adjacent reference groups in make_ref_similarity_names (set to NA for exhaustive testing)
- alternatives: scmap or MUDAN=Alternative cell-type identification tools that operate at the cell-level rather than the cluster-level ;; cellrangerRkit=Recommended for more complex 10X data loading scenarios
- when_to_use: Use when you have a newly clustered single-cell RNA-seq dataset (query) and want to semi-automatically assign biological cell-type labels to these clusters by comparing them to a pre-annotated reference dataset (either single-cell RNA-seq or microarray) of a similar tissue type.
- pitfalls: Small or heterogeneous cell groups may lack statistical power to select enough "top" genes, resulting in uninformative or missing rank distribution plots ;; If pval_to_random is non-significant, "No similarity" will be reported even if there is a significant step-wise p-value (common in small datasets or when matching an "anti-signature") ;; Converting gene IDs (e.g., Ensembl to Gene Symbol) can result in many-to-one mappings; a tie-breaker (like picking the one with higher total read counts) is needed, and consistency is not guaranteed if counts are identical ;; HDF5-backed delayedArray matrices are not directly supported internally for DE calculations unless converted or subsetted, as they are converted to sparse matrices.

workflows.name: scrnaseq_to_scrnaseq_comparison
workflows.intent: Compare a query single-cell RNA-seq dataset to a single-cell RNA-seq reference dataset to annotate query clusters.
input: sim_query_cell_info.tab (query cell metadata with cluster assignments)
sim_ref_cell_info.tab (reference cell metadata with annotated cell types)
workflows.stages:
1. Load query and reference datasets into SummarizedExperiment objects using load_se_from_files.
2. Filter out low-expression genes and small cell groups using trim_small_groups_and_low_expression_genes.
3. Run within-experiment differential expression for both query and reference using contrast_each_group_to_the_rest.
4. Generate rank distribution violin plots using make_ranking_violin_plot.
5. Suggest cluster labels using make_ref_similarity_names.
workflows.code:
toy_ref_se   <- load_se_from_files(counts_file=counts_filepath.ref, cell_info_file=cell_info_filepath.ref)
toy_query_se <- load_se_from_files(counts_file=counts_filepath.query, cell_info_file=cell_info_filepath.query)

toy_ref_se     <- trim_small_groups_and_low_expression_genes(toy_ref_se)
toy_query_se   <- trim_small_groups_and_low_expression_genes(toy_query_se)

de_table.toy_ref   <- contrast_each_group_to_the_rest(toy_ref_se,    dataset_name="ref")
de_table.toy_query <- contrast_each_group_to_the_rest(toy_query_se,  dataset_name="query")

make_ranking_violin_plot(de_table.test=de_table.toy_query, de_table.ref=de_table.toy_ref)

make_ref_similarity_names(de_table.toy_query, de_table.toy_ref)

workflows.name: scrnaseq_to_microarray_comparison
workflows.intent: Compare a query single-cell RNA-seq dataset to a purified cell-type microarray reference dataset to annotate query clusters.
workflows.stages:
1. Load and filter query 10X scRNA-seq dataset using load_dataset_10Xdata and trim_small_groups_and_low_expression_genes.
2. Run within-experiment differential expression for the query using contrast_each_group_to_the_rest.
3. Prepare microarray reference dataset and run within-experiment differential expression using contrast_each_group_to_the_rest_for_norm_ma_with_limma.
4. Compare query to microarray reference using make_ranking_violin_plot.
5. Generate similarity labels using make_ref_similarity_names.
workflows.code:
dataset_se.10X_pbmc4k_k7 <- load_dataset_10Xdata(
   dataset_path   = file.path(datasets_dir,'10X_pbmc4k'),
   dataset_genome = "GRCh38",
   clustering_set = "kmeans_7_clusters",
   id_to_use      = "GeneSymbol")
dataset_se.10X_pbmc4k_k7 <- trim_small_groups_and_low_expression_genes(dataset_se.10X_pbmc4k_k7)

de_table.10X_pbmc4k_k7   <- contrast_each_group_to_the_rest(dataset_se.10X_pbmc4k_k7, dataset_name="10X_pbmc4k_k7", num_cores=7)

de_table.Watkins2009PBMCs <- contrast_each_group_to_the_rest_for_norm_ma_with_limma(
                 norm_expression_table = norm_expression_table.genes,
                 sample_sheet_table    = samples_table,
                 dataset_name          = "Watkins2009PBMCs",
                 extra_factor_name     = 'description',
                 sample_name           = "sampleId",
                 group_name            = 'celltype')

make_ranking_violin_plot(de_table.test=de_table.10X_pbmc4k_k7, de_table.ref=de_table.Watkins2009PBMCs)

make_ranking_violin_plot(de_table.test=de_table.10X_pbmc4k_k7, de_table.ref=de_table.Watkins2009PBMCs, log10trans = TRUE)

label_table.pbmc4k_k7_vs_Watkins2009PBMCs <- make_ref_similarity_names(de_table.10X_pbmc4k_k7, de_table.Watkins2009PBMCs)
